461:t_1:86.en:
$$梅本$$
「It means being together with humans.」

461:t_1:88.en:
$$梅本$$
「When you think about it, it is only natural. Robots are built by humans... and for humans.」

461:t_1:89.en:
$$梅本$$
「But that does not mean using robots as tools that can simply be replaced when they break...」

461:t_1:90.en:
$$梅本$$
「A real robot stands beside humans, sharing their joy and sorrow... It is something you can call a partner.」

461:t_1:91.en:
$$勝平$$
「Oh, is that all? Then my $$ザンボット$$ and $$正太郎$$'s $$鉄人$$ are just like $$トライダー$$!」

461:t_1:92.en:
$$梅本$$
「Exactly. That is why I decided to help you.」

461:t_1:93.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Do you mean during the $$再世戦争$$?」

461:t_1:94.en:
$$梅本$$
「Yes. I could sense that every robot I saw then had shared its pilot's hardships and joys.」

461:t_1:95.en:
$$勝平$$
「...Sorry, Uncle... But isn't that just obvious?」

461:t_1:96.en:
$$梅本$$
「That obvious truth had been lost in $$ガバール星$$'s robot empire.」

461:t_1:97.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Why? Wasn't the mother computer, $$シグマ$$, built to improve human life too?」

461:t_1:98.en:
$$梅本$$
「It was. But one day... without anyone knowing, $$シグマ$$ was taken over and given the goal of destroying human civilization.」

461:t_1:101.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$ガイゾック$$... They're the enemy you fought in the $$ＵＣＷ$$, right, $$勝平$$?」

461:t_1:102.en:
$$勝平$$
「Then why were they on $$ガバール星$$ in the $$ＡＤＷ$$?!」

461:t_1:103.en:
$$梅本$$
「$$ガイゾック$$ seeks to destroy human civilization... We do not know the full picture, but they seem able to travel between parallel worlds...」

461:t_1:104.en:
$$梅本$$
「And apparently have been active for hundreds... perhaps even thousands of years.」

461:t_1:105.en:
$$勝平$$
「So that's why you had data on $$ザンボット３$$, a robot from $$ビアル星$$, Uncle...」

461:t_1:106.en:
$$正太郎$$
「But why... does $$ガイゾック$$ try to destroy human civilization?」

461:t_1:107.en:
$$勝平$$
「I... fought the $$コンピュータードール#pilot$$ they called God, but I never really understood its goal...」

461:t_1:108.en:
$$勝平$$
「All I know is that they called humans evil beings...」

461:t_1:109.en:
$$梅本$$
「The $$コンピュータードール#pilot$$ you faced was probably a different entity from the one that took over $$シグマ$$ on $$ガバール星$$.」

461:t_1:110.en:
$$梅本$$
「But they share the same goal. They are beings that reject humanity.」

461:t_1:112.en:
$$梅本$$
「That concludes my story. Is that enough, $$金田正太郎$$?」

461:t_1:114.en:
$$梅本$$
「I cast that name aside. I am $$梅本$$ now.」

461:t_1:116.en:
$$梅本$$
「You are an honest boy. I'm sure $$ワッ太$$ must be the same.」

461:t_1:117.en:
$$勝平$$
「He sure is. He's as straightforward as they come.」

461:t_1:118.en:
$$梅本$$
「I see. If friends like you say so, then my choice was right after all.」

461:t_1:119.en:
$$梅本$$
「I have done all I can as a scientist. Now I shall put my faith in $$ワッ太$$, whom I entrusted with that power.」

461:t_1:120.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Oh... Excuse me. I have to answer this call.」

461:t_1:121.en:
$$大塚$$
「Can you hear me, $$正太郎$$? A mysterious army of robots has appeared in $$お台場$$. Deploy immediately.」

461:t_1:123.en:
$$勝平$$
「Those bastards! They followed us to $$蒼の地球$$?!」

461:t_1:124.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I'm sorry, $$梅本$$. We... have to go.」

461:t_1:125.en:
$$梅本$$
「Take care. I pray for your victory.」

461:t_1:126.en:
$$勝平$$
「Don't you need to see $$ワッ太$$, Uncle?」

461:t_1:127.en:
$$梅本$$
「I'll do that once peace has returned to this planet.」

461:t_1:128.en:
$$正太郎$$
「All right. We'll do our best to bring that day as soon as possible.」

461:t_1:129.en:
$$勝平$$
「You stay well until then too, Uncle!」

461:t_1:131.en:
$$梅本$$
($$ガバール星$$... A home I will never return to...)

461:t_1:132.en:
$$梅本$$
(But here on Earth, I have built something I can be proud of.)

461:t_1:133.en:
$$梅本$$
($$竹尾$$... I believe in your sons and the robots that stand beside them.)

461:t_2:4.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「...I see. So that's the kind of past $$梅本$$ had.」

461:t_2:6.en:
$$柿小路$$
「He has had his share of hardship too.」

461:t_2:7.en:
$$厚井$$
「A home he will never return to...」

461:t_2:8.en:
$$勝平$$
「If you can't go home, you have to live where you are.」

461:t_2:10.en:
$$勝平$$
「I'm sure my ancestors were just like Uncle $$梅本$$.」

461:t_2:11.en:
$$木下$$
「You mean the $$ビアル星人$$ who were driven from their home, don't you?」

461:t_2:12.en:
$$勝平$$
「I'm sure my ancestors missed the home they couldn't return to at first too.」

461:t_2:13.en:
$$勝平$$
「But they lived as Earthlings. That's why their descendants, me, $$宇宙太$$ and $$恵子$$, are here.」

461:t_2:14.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「Our ancestors must have found hope in living on Earth.」

461:t_2:15.en:
$$恵子$$
「It's the same for $$梅本$$, who managed to build a real robot, $$トライダー$$.」

461:t_2:16.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「...$$勝平$$... Do you think $$梅本$$ will visit me once there's peace...?」

461:t_2:18.en:
$$郁絵$$
「Then, President... Our company's policy is settled.」

461:t_2:19.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Yeah...! $$トライダー$$ is stronger thanks to $$梅本$$, and we'll use it to bring peace back!」

461:t_2:20.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Then I'll thank $$梅本$$. I'll say... Thank you for building $$トライダー$$ for our company.」

461:t_2:21.en:
$$シンジ$$
(A home I will never return to...)

461:t_2:22.en:
$$赤木$$
「$$シンジ$$... Didn't you go out with $n and the others?」

461:t_2:23.en:
$$シンジ$$
「...There's no point in going to $$第２新東京市$$ now...」

461:t_2:24.en:
$$赤木$$
「If that's how you feel, that's fine.」

461:t_2:26.en:
$$赤木$$
「But $$シンジ$$... You can't stop walking.」

461:t_2:27.en:
$$赤木$$
「It's fine if you don't want to look back at the past. Then move forward.」

461:t_2:28.en:
$$赤木$$
「The past is like a home you can never return to. If we can't go back, let's find a new way to live.」

461:t_2:29.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Is that... how you've lived too, $$赤木$$?」

461:t_2:30.en:
$$赤木$$
「That's how I want to live. ...I don't know whether I've managed it myself, though.」

461:t_2:33.en:
$$赤木$$
「Isn't something I'd say so irresponsibly.」

461:t_2:34.en:
$$赤木$$
「But you don't know who wins until the result is in. You won't know anything unless you try.」
